title: SSE connection-probe + chunk provenance protocol for function-call & structured output compatibility
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Define and implement a robust SSE-based streaming protocol extension that adds: 1) connection-probe/heartbeat and backoff-aware reconnect flow, 2) idempotent chunk provenance metadata (ids + parent pointers) so clients can rehydrate partial transcripts and dedupe on reconnect, 3) explicit chunk boundaries for function/tool call emissions and structured JSON delta/final events, and 4) a lightweight backward-compatibility negotiation header so older clients gracefully degrade to the existing framing. This ticket is the integration work across runtime, API gateway, and SDK adapters.
acceptance_criteria: SSE endpoint accepts an optional header X-RW-Stream-Version and negotiates v1 (legacy) or v2 (probe+provenance) behaviors
Server emits periodic connection-probe events when idle; client reconnect flow uses last-acknowledged chunk id and resume-window to avoid duplication
All streaming chunks include provenance metadata: chunk_id, prev_chunk_id (nullable), event_type (delta|final|tool_call|probe), model_seq (token offset) and signature token for integrity checks
Function/tool-call emissions are framed as explicit tool_call events with a deterministic boundary marker; downstream SDKs can reconstruct complete tool input/outputs after reconnect
Backward compatibility: clients sending no X-RW-Stream-Version continue to work with legacy chunk framing and no mandatory provenance fields
Unit and integration tests cover at least: reconnect with mid-token resume, duplicate chunk suppression, tool-call reassembly, and version-negotiation fallbacks
Performance regression <5% p50 latency on 2k token streams and no measurable increase in RPS memory pressure in Dedicated environment
Documentation and migration guide published (Console & SDK changelog)
design_notes: We pick a versioned negotiation model rather than feature-probing in payload to keep the wire simple for CDN and proxies

Probe semantics: server sends `event: probe` with timestamp+nonce every 25s of write-idle. Client must respond with an HTTP reconnect containing `last_chunk_id` and `resume-window` (tokens accepted before repeating) within 45s or treat connection as dead

Provenance fields intentionally minimal to limit token inflation: chunk_id (uuid4), prev_chunk_id (uuid4|null), event_type, model_seq (approx token offset), sig (HMAC sha256 over chunk payload) — sig is optional for low-tier but recommended for enterprise/private deployments

Tool-call framing: tool_call events produce two phases: tool_call:start with metadata (tool name, call_id) then a sequence of delta chunks labeled tool_call, then tool_call:end with final status and return id. This deterministic pattern allows reassembly after reconnect even if mid-call

Compatibility header: X-RW-Stream-Version can be `1` (legacy) or `2` (probe+provenance). If absent, gateway assumes `1` for backward compatibility. SDKs will default to v2 once available and retry with v1 if negotiation fails

We avoid embedding full JSON in every delta chunk to save bytes; structured deltas carry a `payload_type` field (`text/plain` or `application/json/struct`) and chunk fragments are concatenated by clients following provenance order
Security: provenance sig uses request-scoped key tied to API key; rotation handled by gateway. Ensure no PII is added to provenance metadata to comply with audit/GDPR
decision_log: 2026-02-11: Chose versioned header negotiation over embedding `stream_version` in body to reduce proxy incompatibility — agreed by infra and SDK leads (Marcus, Sofia)
2026-02-14: Decided HMAC signature optional for hosted-by-default but required for Private deployments — reduces CPU usage for small requests
2026-02-18: Probe interval finalized at 25s with 45s reconnect window after perf experiments — meets 99.9% reconnection detection without adding noise
implementation_tasks: API gateway: accept X-RW-Stream-Version, attach negotiation result to request context and enforce probe policy (owner: infra-gateway)
Runtime: emit `probe` events and add provenance fields to outgoing chunks when negotiated v2 (owner: serving-runtime)
SDKs: node/python/go adaptors to surface resume API and perform last_chunk_id bookkeeping; add helper to reassemble tool-call sequences (owner: devexp)
Console: update streaming inspector UI to show chunk provenance and reconnect gaps in timeline (owner: console-ux)
QA: create fault-injection harness to simulate mid-token drop, proxy delay, and duped-chunk replay (owner: reliability)
Docs: migration guide + changelog examples for function-call reassembly and compatibility header (owner: docs)
Telemetry: new metric `stream.reconnects.v2_reason` and tracing span updates for resume path (owner: observability)
test_plan: Unit: provenance serializer/deserializer, chunk sig verification, tool-call boundary parser
Integration: end-to-end SSE flow with gateway in front of runtime; simulate TCP drop and reconnect with last_chunk_id replay
Load: 2k concurrent streams in Dedicated staging with v2 negotiated (compare p50/p95 token latency against baseline)
Chaos: proxy-induced 30s delay and 10% mid-stream packet loss to validate idempotency and reassembly
Compatibility: test legacy clients (no header) against v2-capable server to ensure no regressions
rollout_plan: Feature-flag v2 on gateway/runtime behind `sse_provenance_v2` rollout toggle
Canary: enable v2 for 5% internal traffic and SDK beta users for 48 hours, monitor `stream.reconnects` and error budget impact
Gradual ramp to 100% over 7 days if no regressions; automatically rollback if `stream.error.rate` > 0.5% above baseline
Post-rollout: enable HMAC sig enforcement for Private tenants on a separate timeline with customer notice
